_doc: Thresholds of tools/gates/ready.py. Why each one is enough: docs/READINESS.md. Change a threshold only with a journal entry.

equiv_by_design._doc: S11 rules whose differences docs/EQUIVALENCE.md records as by design; S1b sites come from docs/PATCHES.md 'By-design MSVC differences'

static_closed._doc: a non-benign S12 class counts as closed only while its fix is present in this checkout (file + regex)

fuzz_by_design_causes.x87-precision: result within tolerance of x87 80-bit intermediates; AArch64 has IEEE single/double only

perf._doc: frame-rate levels set by the owner (J-0132): below 30 fps fails; 45 fps stable is the target (worst frame); 60 fps is the stretch, even if unstable (median frame). Each frame gate is evaluated at every clock; only clocks with required=true count for the verdict, the others are reported as informative

render_perf._doc: render machine summary (docs/RENDER_PERF.md on that branch): {commit, per_draw_us: {native, nine}, frame_ms: {main, render}, assumptions: {ipc, clock_ghz}}; the frame time is the slower of the main and render threads, scaled from assumptions.clock_ghz to each perf clock, against the perf.fps levels
